stage_C_full_protocol.description: ESN models of stage C (sets H1, HE1, H0; rho 0.6/0.9/1.2; N 300-1000) whose closest attractor reproduces a true hidden attractor (delta_att < 0.2, d_H < 0.2, same kind); one row per model (best-matching hidden attractor); hidden = label hidden_stat; pooled over the six regimes se3, se11, wangchen2, wangchen2_a0.03, chua_I, chua_II; LE1 (attractor hidden only in the weak sense) is excluded and reported separately under le1_separate

loss_origin.note: loss = reproduced hidden attractor labelled self_excited or excited_r (undetermined excluded); 'true' equilibrium (copy) = model equilibrium with dist_true_eq < 0.01, i.e. within 1% of the half-width L = max(box_hi - box_lo)/2 of the region Q from a true one

by_U_in.description: same rows; U_in = unstable equilibria whose physical image W_out r* (stored as x in the stage C record) lies in Q = [box_lo, box_hi]; U_out = U - U_in

logit.model: logit P(hidden_stat) ~ term(s) + [set H1] + [set H0] + log N + [rho 0.6] + [rho 1.2] + regime fixed effects (no intercept; ridge 1e-6); same rows

le1_separate.note: LE1: 'true' (copy) = model equilibrium within 0.01 L of the line x = y = 0; the true attractor is itself reached from a segment of the unstable half-line

N_sweep.description: stage N, lite protocol: closed-loop ESN, rho 0.9, eta 1e-7 and 1e-4, input scale 0.5, density 0.05, sets HE1 (7 regimes) and H1 (se3, se11); rows = (model, true hidden attractor); law sample = reproduced and index sum 1; pooled over the six regimes se3, se11, wangchen2, wangchen2_a0.03, chua_I, chua_II; LE1 (attractor hidden only in the weak sense) is excluded and reported separately under le1_separate

sensitivity_with_le1.note: seven regimes, as before 2026-11-11 (for comparison only)

logit_U2_vs_U1.model: rows with U in {1, 2}: not_excited ~ [U = 2] + [set H1] + log N + regime fixed effects

regime_adjusted_bins.model: not_excited ~ U-bin dummies (vs U = 0) + [set H1] + log N + regime fixed effects (ridge 1e-3); share = mean prediction over all rows with the bin set

U1_vs_U2.note: six regimes (pooled rows); by_regime tables include LE1 for reference

by_U_in.why_not_exact: stage_n.py removes the coordinates x of the equilibria before writing the record (info.pop('x')); only dist_true_eq (to the nearest true equilibrium, in units of L = half of the largest edge of Q) and nearest_true_eq are stored, which bound U_in but do not fix it

stage_C_twins.note: sweep models (rho 0.9, N 300-1000) whose stage C twin has the same training error and the same U; U_in from the stage C coordinates

overlap_with_robustness.note: suffixed runs (_in<x>, _dens<x>) are NOT in the N sweep; the 40 base-setting runs (input 0.5, density 0.05, N 300) have plain names: those with an A100 twin are de-duplicated (A100 file kept), the rest (seeds 3-4) enter the sweep as extra N = 300 models

logit.model: logit P(not_excited) ~ log(1+U) + [set H1] + log N + regime fixed effects (no intercept; ridge 1e-6)

original_check_se3_se11_HE1_N500_700.coarse_classes: candidate = lite not_excited / full hidden_stat or undetermined; excited = self_excited or excited_r; not_reproduced

robustness.description: stage N lite protocol, node_results/N (CPU), se3/se11/le1/chua_I, HE1, N 300, rho 0.9, eta 1e-7/1e-4, seeds 0-4; settings base (input 0.5, density 0.05), input 0.2/1.0, density 0.02/0.2; logic of gpu/analyze_robust.py; pooled bins and fit on se3, se11, chua_I (LE1 separately)
